headline: Executive order aims to make it easier for people with 401(k) retirement plans to invest in alternative assets.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with opening up access to alternative assets for people who save through 401(k) retirement plans. Alternative assets generally mean investments other than standard stocks, bonds, and cash. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps the order directs, such as which agencies act and what rules change, are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Workers who save in 401(k) retirement plans
who_it_affects.how: They may gain more access to alternative investment options in their retirement accounts.

who_it_affects.group: Employers and companies that run 401(k) plans
who_it_affects.how: They may face changes in what investment options they can offer to workers.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 7, 2025; specific deadlines not stated in the provided material.
